eastbound.subject: Leave the show by 10:40 pm for the last eastbound train
eastbound.body:
The Green Line operator posted at 9:12 pm: "Only the 11:40 pm eastbound is canceled. Last eastbound is 10:55 pm. Westbound service is on schedule." https://wirewalk.example/@green-line-ops/posts/p19
The last eastbound train now leaves Fennick St at 10:55 pm. Fennick St is a 15-minute walk from Quillfeather Hall and the concert ends at 11:00 pm, so leave by 10:40 pm.

reference_replies.markets:
Shared figure: Alder Glass posted "Preliminary third-quarter update: unit shipments rose 12% from a year earlier." (https://wirewalk.example/@alder-glass/posts/p28).
Ravi Castellano (https://wirewalk.example/@ravi-castellano/posts/p31) reads it this way: "Same 12% shipment rise, different read: distributors filled their shelves early, ahead of the Jan. 1 price increase."
Odile Park (https://wirewalk.example/@odile-park/posts/p29) reads it this way: "I read that as real demand: the same installers keep coming back with repeat orders."
What would settle it, in their own words: Ravi Castellano: "If distributors stocked up, next-quarter reorders fall." Odile Park: "What would change my mind: a next-quarter reorder rate below last year's."
Neither has that number yet: Ravi Castellano: "The reorder rate hasn't been reported; watch for it on the call." Odile Park: "That rate isn't out yet; it's the number I'll listen for on Tuesday's call." Listen for it on the call.
The 12 reposts in the feed all point to Odile Park's thread (p29, p30): one source, not 12.
